paragraphs: Apply Government Solutions sells hiring software to United States federal agencies and was formerly called MonsterGov. Its system, FedHire, was previously named Monster Hiring Management Enterprise. FedHire is a federal talent acquisition system meant to automate and accelerate federal hiring. It is integrated with USAJOBS, agency HRIT and other OPM systems.

A position classification module automates developing, reviewing, approving, storing and reporting on position descriptions. A job analysis module helps agencies work out the competencies and skills a given job requires. Hiring management handles building and announcing vacancies, tracking applicants and generating certificates. Assessment options can be set up to comply with the Chance to Compete Act and the OPM Merit Hiring Plan. An onboarding module walks new hires through an agency-branded portal so they are ready on their first day.

The company says FedHire has been FedRAMP certified since 2022. It also states that the system complies with Section 508 and OPM requirements. Cabinet-level departments and hundreds of thousands of users are said to rely on it. The company cites more than two decades of domain expertise. Its professional services and industrial-organizational psychology teams work with agencies through classification implementations.
